item.title: Forgotten fossil reveals new Triassic predator from 210 million years ago
item.description: A fossil overlooked for 80 years has been identified as a new crocodile relative that lived 210 million years ago in New Mexico.

item.title: NSF invests $108M in materials science across six research centers
item.description: The U.S. National Science Foundation is funding six advanced research centers with $108 million to push materials science forward.

item.title: Evolution repeats itself among Galapagos plants
item.description: Over 150 years after Darwin's finches reshaped biology, Galapagos giant daisies reveal another evolutionary surprise, showing repeated patterns.

item.title: Alien signals may lurk in overlooked radio bands
item.description: Astronomers may have missed alien signals by focusing on a narrow radio range, leaving a vast unexplored spectrum that could harbor transmissions.
